scheme: int8 symmetric, per-tensor power-of-two scales (weights and activations), MSE-searched exponents
note_input: input code/255 in int8 with scale 2^-7 keeps half of the 256 code levels
note: int8_sim = per-tensor po2 on weights and activations (strict). esp-ppq's esp32p4 config (see model.json) uses per-channel po2 weights + per-tensor po2 activations, which int8_sim_per_channel_weights mirrors; that is the closer estimate of the .espdl. Per-tensor weight scales after BN folding cause most of the strict-sim loss.
